tools.name: weather_convert_time
tools.description: Convert a datetime from one timezone to another. Returns a JSON payload with the original and converted timestamps and the time difference in hours. Accepts 'now' or ISO 8601 input (including trailing 'Z').

datetime_str.description: Datetime to convert. Either the literal string 'now' (case-insensitive, whitespace allowed) or an ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. '2026-03-28T14:30:00', '2026-03-28T14:30:00Z', or '2026-03-28T14:30:00+02:00'). Strings without an offset are interpreted in ``from_timezone``.
datetime_str.title: Datetime Str

tools.name: weather_get_air_quality
tools.description: Get compact air quality information for a city. Returns agent-friendly JSON text with current conditions, summary statistics, and a short hourly sample. Use this for concise analysis.

city.description: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.
city.title: City

variables.description: Optional subset of pollutant variables to query. If omitted, the default compact set is used: pm10, pm2_5, ozone, nitrogen_dioxide, carbon_monoxide. Pass an explicit list when the user asks for a specific pollutant (e.g. ['ozone']) or wants to exclude one.
variables.title: Variables

tools.name: weather_get_air_quality_details
tools.description: Get detailed air quality data for a city as structured JSON text. Use this tool when downstream logic needs raw API-like fields in 'full_data'.

city.description: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.
city.title: City

variables.description: Optional pollutant list. If omitted, the extended default set is used: pm10, pm2_5, ozone, nitrogen_dioxide, carbon_monoxide, sulphur_dioxide, ammonia, dust, aerosol_optical_depth.
variables.title: Variables

tools.name: weather_get_by_range
tools.description: Get weather data for a city between two calendar dates (inclusive). Returns a compact JSON payload optimized for agent analysis, including period metadata, summary statistics, and an hourly sample.

city.description: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.
city.title: City

start_date.description: Start date in ISO 8601 calendar format: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or before end_date.
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: End date in ISO 8601 calendar format: YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). The total range (end_date - start_date + 1) must be <= 16 days.
end_date.title: End Date

tools.name: weather_get_current
tools.description: Get a concise, human-readable snapshot of current weather for a city. Use this tool when you need a short summary (temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation context, pressure, clouds, UV, visibility), not raw datasets.

city.description: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate (for example: 'Springfield, US' or 'London, UK'). Control characters, angle brackets and excessive whitespace are stripped automatically.
city.title: City

tools.name: weather_get_details
tools.description: Get detailed structured JSON weather data for a city. Use this when you need raw fields for downstream processing. Optionally include a short forecast window.

city.description: City name in English, optionally with region/country to disambiguate.
city.title: City

include_forecast.description: When true, attaches a 'forecast' array with the next 24 hours of hourly observations. Defaults to false for a smaller payload.
include_forecast.title: Include Forecast

tools.name: weather_get_time
tools.description: Get the current local datetime for a specific IANA timezone. Returns structured JSON with timezone and ISO 8601 datetime.

timezone_name.description: IANA timezone name (for example: 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'UTC'). Case-sensitive; must match the IANA database exactly. Refer to the ``weather://timezones`` resource for the curated list.
timezone_name.title: Timezone Name

tools.name: weather_get_timezone
tools.description: Get timezone metadata for an IANA timezone as structured JSON: current local time, UTC time, offset in hours, DST flag, and timezone abbreviation. Use this when the user asks about DST, UTC offset, or abbreviation (e.g. 'PST', 'CET').

timezone_name.description: IANA timezone name (for example: 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'Asia/Tokyo'). Refer to ``weather://timezones`` for the curated list.
timezone_name.title: Timezone Name

tools.name: weather_get_status
tools.description: Check the operational status of the weather server.

prompts.name: weather_analysis
prompts.description: Recipe for analysing weather across a date range or across multiple cities. Use when the user wants averages, extremes, comparisons, or 'what was the weather like last week?'.

prompts.name: weather_quick_answer
prompts.description: Recipe for answering a single weather question such as 'How is the weather in <city> right now?'. Returns the system guidance the agent should follow and a user message template containing the city argument.

prompts.name: weather_unit_conversion
prompts.description: Recipe for converting datetimes between timezones or for translating a casual 'what time is it in <city>?' into a tool call. Use when the user mentions another city, country or explicit IANA timezone.

resources.name: weather_aqi
resources.description: Air-quality risk bands per pollutant (PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO) following WHO 2021 / EPA breakpoints. Each band has ``min``, ``max``, ``label`` and an optional ``advice`` recommendation. Use this resource when the user asks whether the air is safe for outdoor activity.

resources.name: weather_codes
resources.description: WMO weather code reference table used by the Open-Meteo API. Each entry has a numeric ``code`` and a human-readable ``description``. Consult this resource whenever the agent needs to translate a numeric code returned by ``weather_get_details`` or ``weather_get_by_range`` into plain text (e.g. code 95 → 'Thunderstorm: slight or moderate').

resources.name: weather_timezones
resources.description: Curated list of commonly-used IANA timezone names with display label and typical UTC offset (DST-aware ranges shown as ``+HH:MM/+HH:MM``). Use this resource whenever the agent must choose an IANA name for ``weather_convert_time`` or ``weather_get_time``.

resource_templates.name: weather_tool_schema
resource_templates.description: Top-level keys returned by the detailed weather/air-quality tools. Pass ``tool_name`` as one of: ``weather_get_details``, ``weather_get_by_range``, ``weather_get_air_quality_details``. Consult this resource before calling those tools so the agent can plan which fields to extract.
